# 楞伽經纂

**ID:** X0325
**Volume:** X17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 楊彥國纂
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 4
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0325

## Contributors
- 楊彥國 (A001442)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X325 in four fascicles is [楊彥國](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A5%8A%E5%BD%A5%E5%9C%8B)'s Sòng-period lay-scholar compendium-cum-commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The author styles himself *Tàilǎo jūrén* 太姥居人 ("Recluse of Mt Tàilǎo", a peak in modern Fújiàn) — a self-presentation as lay Buddhist (居士) rather than monastic. The work is one of the comparatively few Sòng-period lay engagements with the *Laṅkāvatāra* commentarial tradition.

**Abstract**

Date bracket follows the Sòng dynasty more conservatively (1100–1250); the absence of internal dating in the witness and the absence of biographical data on [楊彥國](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A5%8A%E5%BD%A5%E5%9C%8B) beyond the *Tàilǎo jūrén* self-styling makes a finer date bracket unwarrantable. The work is one of two surviving recensions of [楊彥國](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A5%8A%E5%BD%A5%E5%9C%8B)'s text (the other is [KR6i0342](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0342) / C1821, the Zhōnghuá-canon recension preserving [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)'s parent text head-line with Yáng's *quánzhù* below). The doubled transmission is itself a notable feature; for the Sòng *Laṅkāvatāra* commentarial corpus the work is exceeded in scale only by [T1791](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) ([寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3)) and [X323](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0339) ([善月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%9C%88)).

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); parallel Zhōnghuá-canon recension [KR6i0342](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0342) (楞伽經纂 / C1821).
